title: Billing Worksheet Note — Final Month Days Billed Across a Recorded Fee Change (Independent Living)
content:
The monthly fee applied to the days of the final month of an Independent Living Residency Agreement follows any increase recorded on the residency.

## Rule

The recorded fee is the monthly service fee in effect on the residency record, with its rate effective date.

| Rate effective date of the recorded fee | Days of the final month billed at |
|---|---|
| The first day of the final month | Every day at the recorded fee |
| A later day that is on or before the fee end date | The days before it at the fee of the latest full-month base fee charge, and the days from it at the recorded fee, each span divided by 30 |
| Any other date (on or before the last day already billed, or after the fee end date) | Every day at the fee of the latest full-month base fee charge |

Each span's amount is its fee divided by 30 and multiplied by its days; the spans are added before any rounding.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Final month April; fee end date April 19 (19 days); latest full-month base fee charge 4,000.00; recorded fee 4,200.00.

| Rate effective date | Computation | Amount before rounding |
|---|---|---|
| April 1 | 4,200.00 divided by 30, multiplied by 19 | 2,660.00 |
| April 10 | 4,000.00 divided by 30, multiplied by 9 (April 1–9), plus 4,200.00 divided by 30, multiplied by 10 (April 10–19) | 1,200.00 plus 1,400.00, that is 2,600.00 |
| April 25 | 4,000.00 divided by 30, multiplied by 19 | 2,533.3333… |
| January 1 (already billed) | 4,000.00 divided by 30, multiplied by 19 | 2,533.3333… |
